admin.title: Rule console
admin.subtitle: Author, test, review and publish rotation rule packs. Every change is audited.
admin.packsIntro: Published packs are used for every new plan. Drafts never reach farmers.
admin.editorIntro: Edit YAML. The schema is checked as you type. Code is never allowed in a rule pack.
admin.validationOk: The document is valid YAML and matches the required structure.
admin.schemaHint: Required fields: pack_id, version, status, seasons, families, season_gate, hard_rules, moisture_gate.
admin.diffPrevious: Visual diff against the previous version
admin.noDiff: No changes against the base version.
admin.workflowHint: Draft → Agronomist review → Approved → Published. Publishing needs two different people.
admin.twoPersonHint: You cannot approve or publish a pack that you created. Ask a second reviewer.
admin.mfaIntro: Admin and agronomist actions need a second factor.
admin.goldenIntro: The pack cannot be published until every golden test passes.
admin.testsFailed: {count} golden tests failed. Publishing is blocked.
admin.blockedPublish: Publishing is blocked until the golden tests pass.
admin.simulatorIntro: Run sample inputs against this draft. The trace shows which rules produced each choice.
admin.officersIntro: Review self-registered extension officers. Only approved officers can sign in and access field tools.
admin.officerApprovedToast: Extension officer approved. They can now sign in.
admin.auditIntro: Append-only record of rule and user changes.
admin.rollbackSuccess: Rolled back. The previous published pack is active again.
admin.approvedSuccess: Pack approved. A second person can now publish it.
admin.demoAdminHint: Demo rule console. Changes are stored in this browser only.
admin.adminOnly: Only agronomists and administrators can use the rule console.
admin.loadError: We could not load the rule packs.
admin.saveError: The draft could not be saved.
admin.testsError: The golden tests could not run.
admin.auditError: The audit log could not be loaded.
admin.cannotEdit: Only draft packs can be edited.
admin.cannotSubmit: Only drafts can be sent for review.
admin.cannotApprove: Only packs in review can be approved.
admin.cannotPublish: Only approved packs can be published.
admin.notYourPack: This pack was created by you. A different person must approve or publish it.
admin.invalidMfa: The authenticator code is not correct.
admin.rollbackConfirm: Roll back the active pack to {version}?
admin.packListError: Rule pack list could not be loaded.
admin.noTrace: Run a simulation to see the rule trace.
admin.approvalRoleNote: Agronomist approval is required. Administrators publish.
admin.diffAria: Line-by-line difference against the previous version
admin.translationsIntro: Coverage of each locale against the English key set. Pending keys fall back to English at runtime.
